Game Overview

At its heart, Redmax is a platformer game about race against a colossal cube monster in Redmax, collecting keys and coins to navigate through challenging levels. Master the double jump and strategize your movements to reunite with friends, offering a fast-paced and thrilling escape experience. Dive into a captivating world of strategic running adventures.
